title: Star in Dallas
text: Star in Dallas put fans and their friends into a personalized version of the show’s opening credits. I contributed JavaScript development to the experience on TNT’s Dallas website. Visitors connected through Facebook, and the resulting sequence combined personal material with the format of the television introduction. By combining the Facebook and Google Maps APIs, we created personalized opening credits starring visitors’ friends, family, and hometown, turning the show’s familiar opening into something personal.
summary: I contributed JavaScript development to TNT’s Star in Dallas experience, which turned visitors and their Facebook friends into the cast of personalized opening credits.
